name: Approvals Manager
summary: A company employee who reviews already-analyzed documents and makes the final approve/escalate decision.
description: The downstream decision-maker in the document-approval workflow, one step after the accounts-payable clerk's intake. Uses doc-approval.recommend to independently recompute a document's approvability from its actual extracted signals, rather than trusting a claimed confidence score at face value -- so a document whose analysis claims high confidence but has no real supporting extracted data gets caught and downgraded instead of silently auto-approved. Never handles the raw incoming document directly; only ever works from documents doc-approval.analyze has already processed.

distinguished_from.how: Reviews and decides on documents the clerk's tooling has already analyzed; does not do the initial intake, submission, or raw-document handling.
Reviews vendor documents for approval, not meeting transcripts -- a different internal workflow and a different capability entirely.
